name: contrast-probe
description: NOT A SHIPPING LOOK. A permanent test fixture whose only job is to be maximally unlike ink-wash in every token, so tests/test_theme_binding.py can prove a component actually reads the theme it is handed. Deleting this file after one run destroys the proof for every future run — it stays. Every value here is deliberately the opposite of ink-wash: bright where ink-wash is dark, hard where it is soft, Screen where it is Multiply.
